summary: Lucas GC Limited, a Cayman-incorporated NASDAQ-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that its extraordinary general meeting was held October 2, 2026, with 61.3% of voting power present. Shareholders ratified a 125-for-1 share consolidation effective September 1, 2026, reducing authorized capital to 20,000,000 shares of US$0.025 par value, and approved amended articles plus a notice-period amendment. All three proposals passed. The filing is a routine EGM results notice, not a special situation; the reverse split is a mechanical capital-structure change. Watch for post-consolidation trading and compliance effects.
